nom: OLEHENRIKSEN Banana Bright Mineral Face Sunscreen SPF 30

avis.titre: My favorite part of my skincare routine
avis.texte: I was a late adopter to daily sunscreen and really pushed back on my dermo recommending mineral only, until I tried this. This one is different, It smells fresh and delicious like oranges and leaves no cast. Will repurchase forever!
I purchased this a couple months ago and i've been using it as a daily sunscreen during the summer. It's a nice consistency. Sometimes there is some pilling, but overall it's a decent sunscreen.

I almost never buy the same sunscreen twice because I never like them enough to repeat purchase, but here we are. This is not perfect, but it is very close. It disappears instantly and leaves no white cast - I think even those with darker skin tones could wear it (it is just barely tinted but not enough to impart any sort of color to the skin). The finish is natural matte - no shine or greasiness. I don't see the "glow" it claims to give, but I don't care about that. It smells nice and fresh, like a just peeled orange. The texture is a bit like mousse, but once you put it on it kind of liquifies and blends right in. It can definitely be a bit drying, like all zinc-based sunscreens, so absolutely start with a good moisturizer. I would recommend it for all but the very driest of skin.

This product is fantastic, I was excited to try as I use the other banana bright lotions. It goes on the same, very smooth and I love the color, just gives a glow but nothing too dark or heavy. Wore it all day on my face at the beach and did not get burned.
I must be sensitive to an ingredient in this sunscreen, because it made my skin red and irritated- very stingy. I like everything else about the sunscreen, so it's such a bummer.
I adore this mineral sunscreen, it absorbs beautifully and smells delicious, like oranges. The only facial mineral sunscreen I will wear.
Foundation doesnt blend good with this sunscreen. Would be ok if used alone and wasnt applying a full face.

This was recommened to me by a staff member at ulta and im glad he did. I only used cetaphil spf before because of my sensitive skin and it doesnt leave me dry, but this is a wonderful product. It leaves me hydrated but not greasy or oily. It has a nice smell and leaves my skin feeling really great. I dont wear make up daily, so for me i have not noticed any peeling as others reviewed. I use alot of water based skin care products not sure if that makes a difference. I will def keep buying!
This is a really wonderful mineral SPF. I use this over the new Vitamin C moisturizer and the combo is great under makeup. Almost out of my first tube, will purchase a second one for sure!

I was hoping this would fall in like with the rest of their products which are very hydrating & glowy. This unfortunately dried my skin out & left it feeling chalky & matte. It also peels. I have used many mineral sunscreens & know that it can cause issues like this but there are others I have tried that don't.
I wanted to live this product but it pilled on my face :/ it also smells like oranges which is fine, but you're sensitive to fragrances, watch out
Only purchased once and probably wont again. Tried to love it

avis.titre: Love the finish but irritating for sensitive skin
avis.texte: At first I loved this sunscreen. It has a great finish that is both matte and glowy. But as the day went on I noticed it was drying. Its also scented which I didnt like and is always a red flag for sensitive skin people like myself (and most people who use mineral SPF…) also the tint could look a little streaky depending on your complexion. Wanted to love but ultimately returned.

avis.titre: Great but wish it had no fragrance
avis.texte: Loved it in the beginning but saw it had fragrance. I have really sensitive skin so over time it made my skin really dry at the end which is shocking considering i have oily combo skin. No white white cast which is a bonus! Would've been perfect if it had no fragrance.

avis.titre: It's Okay If You Don't Wear Makeup
avis.texte: I was so interested in trying this sunscreen, and it's just okay. The scent is really nice and doesn't irritate my skin, and it gives a pretty glow. My only problems are that it can make the skin feel dry, which is odd, for it leaving the skin looking dewy. And it is the worst under makeup. It pills and leaves the skin looking flaky. It's just a good sunscreen if you don't wear base makeup or no makeup at all.

avis.titre: Wears great alone, iffy under makeup
avis.texte: I was very grateful to learn that my SPF sensitivity was most likely caused by chemical sunscreen, and that mineral sunscreen may not burn me the same way. This one holds up! Felt very moisturizing and went on smoothly, no burning and no watery eyes. However, it did pill quite a bit when i applied makeup over it. I'm not sure if this is because i was mixing oil and water based products, but i will keep experimenting. If you are just looking for an everyday sunscreen, i would definitely recommend.

This is hands down the best mineral sunscreen I've tried, and I've tried a lot. It doesnt leave a white/purple cast, but its also not pigmented. It doesnt have that chalky feeling that a lot of mineral sunscreens have either. It leaves a really nice glowy finish, but not greasy. I have sensitive skin but havent had any issues with this. Only con is the smell, its pretty strong but not terrible. It is a mineral sunscreen, so you can feel it more on your skin than chemical sunscreens but not too bad. I havent noticed any issues with makeup either. I wait 5-10 minutes after moisturizer to apply this, then wait another 5-10 before starting makeup.

avis.titre: I'm in love and I don't care who knows it
avis.texte: I don't know what witchcraft is in this bottle but it totally changes the appearance of my skin (in a good way lol). It's even and dewey and clear. I no longer wear my tinted lotion because my skin looks so good with just this sunscreen on. Will buy for life.

I am not a sunscreen user mostly because I do not like the thickness, casts and smells that typically acompany them. This one however, is gold! It smells like an orange smoothy, feels like a light moisturizure, and wears with zero "sunscreen" feeling! Its seriously so so good! It can be worn under makeup as well which is always a plus.

avis.titre: My favorite spf for the face
avis.texte: This smells amazing and rubs in like a lotion. It brightens and leaves a dewy finish. My skin is glowing even after I apply makeup. It's water based like all my products and wears perfectly under my makeup. I just wait 1 minute between moisturizer and this spf. Then wait another minute before applying my primer, then I wait another minute to apply my foundation just to let each step set well. Seriously love this stuff.
Peals off my skin and when I do it under makeup it lifts my makeup off that I have separation, and pealing flakes all over my face.

Haven't written a review in years but I adore this product and thought I should explain why. I have combination, acne-prone skin. This absorbs quickly, does not leave you greasy, and does not pill under makeup. It does not break me out or cause redness. Also, no white cast. Fresh subtle citrus scent that is not over-powering. I will continue to repurchase.

I love this sunscreen so much it truly brightens your skin so much. My skin looks so much better when i use this specific sunscreen over any other ones. Only problem is it is a little sticky so you have to wait awhile to do your makeup but still great.
if you like a more matte sunscreen or have oily skin this would be great. i have pretty normal skin, definitely not dry but not oily either and this sunscreen works great for me. love Olehenriksen!

I have sensitive skin so maybe it was the Vitamin C that burned my face but whenever I put this on my skin burned so bad! I was inflamed something terrible. I am dark skin and this did leave a slight white cast on my face but nothing too crazy. All my other skin care is from OLE but i couldnt do the sunscreen sadly.

I was so excited when this came in because I had called and asked for a sunscreen. I hate the smell of most sunscreen, but this smells like oranges. It is very light and glides on smoothly. My only complaint is that it stained a white colored shirt. Otherwise this is perfect!
Welcome back Ole sunscreen!!! After several years of no Ole sunscreen you have brought back a Real Gem!! Wonderful skin feel and covers great. Thank you!!
Love this sunscreen on my highly sensitve skin. It does brighten a bit and love the protection with a hint of coverage.On my second tube!!
Great mineral sunscreen. Love the smell and feel on my skin. Use it everyday

So far so good. Love the smooth application, and lack of white cast on my already pale skin. Also the scent is very subtle, and lovely, and not reminiscent of mineral sunscreen at all which is fantastic. Thank you so much for the wonderful products, I look forward to spending my summer with it.
Gives me a hint of color slightly covering my rosacea. Lightweight!

I've been on the hunt for a while now trying to find a new SPF that has clean ingredients, isn' heavy feeling, sinks into the skin and does not leave a white cast. This marks all the boxes. It's truly incredible. Please don' ever stop making it!!!
Very good sunscreen. Although it has zinc, it is very light and keeps your skin well protected. Smells great too!

I just returned from the Bahamas and only used this for my face. I am fair skinned but do tan. Typically sunscreens somehow get in my eyes and my eyes are teary and blurry every vacation. I must be sensitive to something in them. This had NONE of that. Smells fruity. Application is fantastic and the coverage outlasted 87F and 11 heat index. HIGHLY recommend for those who may experience eye sensitivity! This is the best!!

All my skin care is from OleH I love this brand, so I was thrilled about the new sunscreen! Bought it, right away it's really thick texture, I have to squeeze a lot of product out to cover my face and neck. I expected the texture to be like the primer or the brightening crÃ¨me which I love, I'm not in love with this product.

Best of the mineral sunscreens I've tried so far, it has no white cast, blends well, plays nice with makeup and skincare products like Vitamin C, and has a pleasant lemony scent that doesnt linger. The only problem is I need to reapply more often as SPF is only 30 not 50 and unknown PA rating against UVA rays, otherwise I love this sunscreen and it is pleasant to reapply in humid weather!
For me, it is too thick and too difficult to evenly apply. Don't care for it at all.

avis.titre: First sunscreen I look forward to put on every morning
avis.texte: I reacted badly with banana bright eye cream, but it seemed that ethylated ascorbic acid was the culprit, so I gave this a try, and it works! I really wanted silicone/harmful ingredients-free mineral sunscreen. My skin felt a bit sensitive probably because fragrance but it got used to it. And, not sticky/greasy, and leaves skin in lovely texture. First sunscreen I truly enjoy.
This has replaced my foundation for the summer. It leaves my skin soft, dewy, and glowy. I am absolutely in love. Please don' ever discontinue it!

I'm really enjoying this beautiful sunscreen - it adds a touch of brightness and evens out my skin too, without looking like makeup. Great for those casual, light-to-no makeup days, and layers well too if you add foundation over it.
I loved the under eye cream in this same line. So I thought I'd give the face crÃ¨me a try. Clogs my pores and leaves residue, not a good base for makeup either.
It is a thick facial moisturizer which is why I can' give it a full 5 stars, but it smells great and once rubbed in, it is buildable with your makeup.
ITS THE BEST !!! It goes in so light and I use all their face banana bright products so I've been waiting for this!!! NOW WE NEED A BODY ONE WITH THE SAME SMELL !!!!!
Absolutely love this product. Great as a primer to makeup also.
Takes a long time to set but once it sets it feels like nothing is there. My skin is a little sensitive to the fragrance but nothing too much.

I told you this is a must-have. I'm not playing it super light in the face, and it smells so good! But not overwhelming it leaves your skin so bright and nice and yes if course apply every 2 to 3 hours! Thank you!!! Complimentary from Ole Henriksen
This Sunscreen is the BEST I have EVER Used.!!! The smell is not overwhelming and it feels by light and not greasy. It's a great primer for my foundation. Love Love Love:heart:ï¸
I have combination to dry skin this works the best I use it for work every morning I don' need no foundation and makes my skin so nice and smooth
It feels super light on the skinand has a light hue that makes your skin look fabulous
Leaves skin looking glowy and bright, feels smooth and not pasty like most sunscreen creams
This is the best sunscreen I've ever used. It's light, doesn' irritate my skin and leaves it looking better.
Love the smell, texture and feel of the cream. Haven' had any sun so can' say if it works in that department yet.
This sunscreen is perfect for natural look/no makeup days. It brightens my skin and there is no need to apply my powder foundation. Also, it improves my skin texture.

As a person who has had several skin cancers on my face, this sunscreen is a game changer. I cannot leave home without sunscreen on my face and the brightness that this one provides makes me feel alive vs. the others that make me look like a ghost!

Ole Henriksen gifted me the Banana Bright Mineral Sumscreen and it has become a part of my daily routine! It's skincare and sun care in one! Vitamin C & Niaminicide are what makes this sunscreen much more than sun protection! Mineral sunscreen give the best protection from the sun's harmful effects making this product a powerhouse anti-aging skincare product. It doesn' leave a white cast. It's so lightweight and feels like nothing on the skin. It's the last step in my skincare routine before makeup! Bonus! It helps correct redness and gives my skin a luminous glow! I liked this product better than the populate Supergoop! Glow Screen

I never thought that a sunscreen could be THIS life-changing. I received this product complimentary from Ole Henriksen. I'm already a big fan of their products, so I had high hopes for this sunscreen to begin with. However, I didn't think I would be raving over it the way I am. First off, the scent of this product is of citrus & orange. It has ZERO sunscreen smell (which is usually the reason why I dislike wearing SPF daily). It is moisturizing, does not leave any white cast & actually gives me the most beautiful glow. I paired this on top of moisturizer my first time using it, but it honestly is perfect on its own. The SPF 30 is perfect for me as I don't burn easily, and I will be using this everyday all Spring & Summer long! Ole Henriksen did it again!!

So happy I got to try this sunscreen that was gifted by Ole Henriksen. I usually prefer chemical sunscreens because mineral ones have a tendency to have a white cast. But this didn' have one! I like how this is lightly tinted and smells so good. Can' wait to see its brightening effects with long term use.

This product was complimentary from Ole Henriksen. This sunscreen is okay to me. I do like the faint smell of banana however, I find it hard to blend into my skin since it is slightly thicker. It also leaves me with a white cast no matter how much I try to blend it (I have darker skin/am black for reference).

I love the scent of this. The natural orange is so uplifting especially in the mornings to help wake me up and put me in a good mood! I love all of the ingredients in this. The tint is still a little light for my skin tone, but I can make it work. Gifted by Ole Henriksen.

Complimentary from Ole Henriksen and wow! This may be my new go to. It's lightweight and gives my skin a healthy glow, with no overwhelming fragrance. I am excited to see the long term results from all of the amazing ingredients as well!

I love this product!! I was super excited to have it gifted by Ole Henriksen to add it with my banana bright primer and ooh they just go so great together!! Get the natural brightness with the primer while having spf protection- yes please!:raised_hands::skin-tone-4:

I like to use mineral sunscreen. The only concern about such SPFs is the possible white casting. Luckily, for this new SPF from Ole Henriksen, there's no white casting at all! It combines banana bright pigment, so it's very user friendly to any skin tones. I feel my skin smoother and brighter after applying. Definitely recommend it for summer use! [Gifted by Ole Henriksen]

This was complimentary from Ole Henriksen. The smell is so good, I love how it brightens up with the light light hint of tint. It did not break me out and did not feel oily. I love his Banana line, I have tried the other products and this one is a great addition!

I was gifted this by Ole Henriksen via Skeepers and I'm so thankful that I was! I just Love this!! I'm not into glowy spfs in the summer (my combo skin is glowy enough). This spf has so many skincare properties but also mattifies the skin. It wears beautifully under makeup and has a wonderful citrus scent. This is definitely my new summer time staple! Gifted by Ole Henriksen

This sunscreen has a soft yellow tone that allows it to blend seamlessly into any skin tone! I have a medium to tan complexion and the yellow tone not only blends in invisibly but it brightens the overall tone of my skin! I find that especially in the winter, my skin looks very dull and it has discoloration. This sunscreen helps brighten any darkness and discoloration on the skin, making my skin look fresh and healthy! It definitely gives my skin a beautiful glow without makeup. It has a balmy texture that blends into the skin easily and it allows you to apply makeup on immediately without any pilling or texture issues. This is a fantastic formula and I can' recommend it enough! Gifted by Ole Henriksen.

This has fast become my favorite mineral sunscreen. It has such a beautiful finish and it looks great on my skin. I love the fact that it perfects my skin as well. This is definitely the sunscreen I am going to take with me on a vacation. This was kindly gifted by Ole Henriksen.

I was excited to try out this sunscreen Olehenriksen gifted me, but unfortunately it does give a white cast on my dark skin. However, it has a lovely citrus scent, the texture is consistent, not too thick but comes off like a lotion moisturiser. It doesn' dry out the skin, but leaves it feeling moisturised.

I'm loving the creamy texture and consistency of the mineral sunscreen #OleHenriksengiftedme . The natural scent of citrus is refreshing and screams summertime. It glides on and absorbs easily without leaving any white cast. I really like that the SPF's finish doesn' feel greasy; it does feels hydrating. I love the packaging and the effective vegan ingredients.

I use sunscreen daily, especially on my face that's exposed no matter what season it is. I've been enjoying using this sunscreen. It feels so lightweight on my face and didn't feel greasy at all. Gifted by Ole Henriksen

gifted by Ole henriksen This banana bright mineral spf 30 is my goto for any travel or occassions. It is absolutely perfect formula and the texture of this spf is really great. No white cast and totally beautiful , blendable.

This product was gifted to me by Ole Henriksen. This is my full honest review. I love using this sunscreen. It totally plays well alone or with my makeup. I love the soft citrus scent as well. I also felt like it was nourishing on my normal to dry skin. Over all I would recommend this sunscreen. I think you will be happy with it.

I really enjoy this sunscreen on my no makeup days. I love that it has vitamin c in it and actively works throughout the day on my skin. As a brown woman, it does brighten my face without a white or grey cast. However, if you're darker, it may create a white or grey cast. My forehead is a little tanned, and yet there's no cast - only brightening. But I cannot be 100% sure on how that would wear on anyone else. The sunscreen was gifted by Ole Henriksen.

Gifted by ole Hendriksen, I'm legit obsessed with this banana bright mineral sunscreen. I love the soft creamy texture that instantly absorbs into skin. While it nourishes and protects skin from sun damage it give such a beautiful radiant glow to the skin. It definitely doesn' leave any white cast so I can wear it just by itself or with makeup.

I'm obsessed with this sunscreen that I was gifted by Ole Henriksen. I have been on the hunt for a sunscreen that doesn' FEEL like sunscreen, smell like sunscreen, or burn my eyes throughout the day. This checks all the boxes and on top of it all, sits beautifully underneath makeup. Would be perfect for mature skin as well. Absolutely love it.

I've been enjoying this sunscreen. It has a mild citrus scent and a creamy texture. It's tinted, so it leaves zero white cast. It is moisturizing, with no greasy feel. It also provides adequate sun protection. Gifted by Ole Henriksen.

Gifted to me by ole henriksen Goes on so smooth under makeup and makes skin so Glowy! I love that it's spf 30! And it also leaves my skin feeling hydrated and plump! No white residue! Also blends into skin flawlessly love this stuff!

It has the traditional smell, so good. Nice glow yet not greasy or white. Absorbs so well that doesnt ruin the makeup. I love the skincare that is mix with the spf. Protection and benefits for the skin â€œgifted by ole henriksen

Gifted by Ole Henriksen. I like that this sunscreen is lightweight and doesn' leave a white cast or any sticky residue on my face. I have dry skin and this does a good job hydrating me and sits well under my makeup. It has a citrus scent but is not overwhelming. Will recommend

I recently had the opportunity to try the Ole Henriksen Banana Bright Mineral Sunscreen SPF 30, gifted to me by Ole Henriksen, and I must say, it has exceeded my expectations. The lightweight and non-greasy texture make it perfect for everyday wear, and it absorbs quickly into the skin, leaving a subtle glow and a smooth finish. What's more, the sunscreen provides broad-spectrum protection against UVA and UVB rays and is formulated with banana powder to help even out skin tone and brighten the complexion. I have noticed a visible improvement in the overall brightness and radiance of my skin since incorporating this sunscreen into my daily routine. As someone with sensitive skin, I was pleased to find that this sunscreen did not cause any irritation or breakouts. It is also free of harmful chemicals like oxybenzone and octinoxate, which is essential for me. Overall, I highly recommend the Ole Henriksen Banana Bright Mineral Sunscreen SPF 30 to anyone looking for a high-quality daily sunscreen that provides both sun protection and skin benefits. I am grateful for this complimentary gift from Ole Henriksen and look forward to trying more of their products in the future.

This product was gifted by Ole Henriksen. I love the way this product feels on my skin. It's non-greasy and lightweight for when I want to add makeup on top. The effective ingredients make it even better! This product has become my holy grail for an everyday look.

(OleHenriksen gifted me) As a fellow sunscreen lover who wears SPF daily, I had to try this out and it has become one of my favorites! It does have a light citrus scent to it which I don' mind and it has a matte finish on the skin. I like to wear this together with my banana bright eye cream in the morning to give that glowy vibrant look.

I received this complimentary from Ole Henriksen. I am super pleased with this SPF. I have wore this on my skin itself and it provided my dry skin with enough slip and hydration for the first two hours, until the reapplication. It has a very light illumination, as well as a light citrus scent that dissipates after about 20 minutes or so. It's not irritating to my extremely sensitive eyes and it actually sinks in and dries down. Leaving no oiliness on top of the skin. Even after a few reapplications. I wish this was more affordable but it's not. Also, no cast of any sorts. I love this.

I'm really enjoying this sunscreen. It goes on smoothly and doesn't leave a greasy residue on my skin. I personally didn' notice a white cast, which is a huge plus. It has a nice citrusy sent, and they really well under make-up. Gifted by Ole Hendrickson.

This sunscreen has a lot of potential when you take a look at the ingredients. I don' see many sunscreens that use tetrahexydecyl ascorbate. It doesn' smell like your typical sunscreen either, it has a nice citrusy scent. I don' think this sunscreen is for me though, it left a slight cast on my face especially near my hairline. The texture is thick and it dried down too quickly for me to rub it all the way in. I think people who have oily skin and are less melanated might appreciate this more. Glad this was gifted by Ole Henriksen to test out.

This is my favorite sunscreen! It was gifted by Ole Henriksen. But I would buy it again and again. I don' feel like I have to wear any make up on top of it because it brightens my complexion that much! And it smells amazing, definitely not like I'm wearing sunscreen!
